sources.note: Local test feed returned a CSV with 48 half-hourly time/value rows for 2026-03-10, no authentication required.
Returned HTTP 401 with JSON body 'API key required' and WWW-Authenticate: Bearer header, indicating an API key is needed.

The Elexon Insights API at developer.data.elexon.co.uk states no API key is required, but attempt 1 (data.elexon.co.uk/bmrs/api/v1/datasets/B1770) returned 404 and attempt 2 (bmrs.elexon.co.uk/api/datasets/B1770) returned 200 but served a React SPA rather than data, so no data could be retrieved.
The NESO data portal at api.neso.energy uses CKAN and requires a resource ID to query historic demand data; the resource ID was not obtained before the search limit was reached.
Not attempted; the correct URL for the embedded wind and solar forecast CKAN resource could not be found within the search limit.

Both API attempts returned 404: attempt 1 used the v1 API path (pvlive/api/v1/pvlive/gsp) and attempt 2 used the v4 path (pvlive/api/v4/gsp/) as described in the user guide, but neither returned data for 2026-03-10.
Open-Meteo ERA5 archive returned 24 hourly temperature_2m readings for 2026-03-10 at (51.51, -0.13) with no authentication required.
Not attempted; the Open-Meteo historical forecast archive URL pattern was not resolved before the search limit was reached.
